shots.brief: locked-off tripod shot with composited ghost overlay racing yourself (ref: Static locked-off shot of a running track. A runner stops, looks back as a transparent clone of himself sprints past, and then starts sprinting alongside his ghost self.; tripod)

special: Locked-off tripod composite shot filmed twice in the same setting (one run overlayed with lowered opacity to create a ghost clone)
audit.notes: This visual trick requires a locked-off tripod setup filmed twice in identical conditions so one clip can be layered over the other with reduced opacity. It cannot be recreated using generic handheld lifestyle b-roll.
audit.summary: A runner on an outdoor track begins racing against a translucent 'ghost' clone of himself, visually representing 'You vs. You'.
